about: Sectors 3, 4 and 9, Noida: the three JindalX options A104, A14/18/19 and D1, with Noida Sector 15 and Sector 16 on the Blue Line. Pins are indicative (jindalx/build-data.cjs); the plots await landlord confirmation.
towers_note: Sectors 3, 4 and 9 are G+2 to G+5 industrial and office plots: no estimated towers, and estimated heights capped at 24 m (the 30 m surface model reads low blocks too tall, as in Andheri). Overture's own heights are kept.
trees_note: Noida sectors: avenue planting along the main roads, dense planting in parks, a thin scatter elsewhere (the random scatter over all open ground made a carpet: VISUAL_REALISM_AUDIT.md)
greens_note: Trees only where open data shows greenery: Sentinel-2 L2A NDVI (fetch_ndvi.py) read as canopy cover plus Overture parks; avenue rows only along roads whose NDVI shows an avenue; no scatter over built-up blocks. Needs DATA/ndvi.npy and ndvi_t.json. open_tree_density and roadside_tree_density apply only to the older random scatter.
walls_note: Compound walls round plots that stand in their own ground (see diorama.py boundary_walls): 1.8 to 2.4 m plastered wall with pillars and coping, a gate on the street face, none where buildings stand shoulder to shoulder on the lane. Solid for walk mode.
